Token name string stored in contract storage of SuomenMarkka.

SafeMath.safeAdd: computes c = a + b with an overflow require.
SafeMath.safeSub: computes c = a - b with an underflow require.
SafeMath.safeMul: computes c = a * b with an overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: computes c = a / b after requiring b > 0.
Owned() constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that nominates a new owner (writes newOwner).
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner and rewrites owner/newOwner.
Token constructor: initialises symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-funds the deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Read-only accessor returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from `from` to `to` and decrements the caller allowance via safeSub.
Read-only accessor returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external receiveApproval call to the spender contract.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
onlyOwner function performing an arbitrary external token transfer out of this contract.
Caller-controlled address used for authorisation checks and balance math.
Unchecked-style addition `c = a + b` inside SafeMath.safeAdd.
Subtraction `c = a - b` inside SafeMath.safeSub.
Multiplication `c = a * b` inside SafeMath.safeMul.
Division `c = a / b` inside SafeMath.safeDiv.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary token contract.

edges.reason: Owned() constructor takes the caller address as the initial privileged owner.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body executes.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on the caller address.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete the handover.
Caller-supplied _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the nominated address in newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the previously pending newOwner.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] as the source of funds.
transfer writes the debited sender balance and credited recipient balance.
transfer loads current balances before performing the arithmetic.
The to parameter is used as the credit destination index.
The tokens parameter is the amount subtracted/added in the balance updates.
transfer delegates the debit arithmetic to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit arithmetic to SafeMath.safeAdd.
safeAdd operand a feeds the addition expression.
safeAdd operand b feeds the addition expression.
safeAdd executes the c = a + b arithmetic operation.
safeAdd assigns the computed sum to local c.
safeSub minuend parameter feeds the subtraction.
safeSub subtrahend parameter feeds the subtraction.
safeSub executes the c = a - b arithmetic operation.
safeSub assigns the computed difference to local c.
safeMul first factor feeds the multiplication.
safeMul second factor feeds the multiplication.
safeMul executes the c = a * b arithmetic operation.
safeMul assigns the computed product to local c.
safeDiv dividend feeds the division.
safeDiv divisor feeds the division and the b > 0 guard.
safeDiv executes the c = a / b arithmetic operation.
safeDiv assigns the computed quotient to local c.
approve indexes allowed with msg.sender as the allowance owner.
The spender parameter is the second key of the allowance mapping.
The tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value.
approve writes the granted amount into allowed.
approve reads/updates the allowance mapping entry.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
The from parameter indexes both balances and allowed in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the destination of the delegated transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved and deducted from the allowance.
transferFrom reads balances[from] before debiting.
transferFrom writes updated balances for both from and to.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] before decrementing.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into allowed.
transferFrom delegates debits to SafeMath.safeSub (balance and allowance).
transferFrom delegates the credit to SafeMath.safeAdd.
balanceOf returns the entry selected by the tokenOwner parameter.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance() uses tokenOwner as the first mapping key.
allowance() uses spender as the second mapping key.
allowance() reads the allowed nested mapping.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply rebased by the zero-address balance.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] in the returned expression.
Constructor initialises _totalSupply to the fixed supply.
Constructor pre-funds the hard-coded deployer balance.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
approveAndCall indexes allowed with msg.sender and forwards it to the callback.
The spender parameter becomes the target contract of the external call.
The tokens parameter is both stored as allowance and passed to the callback.
Attacker-controlled data bytes are forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed before the external call.
The caller-chosen spender address determines the callee of the receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall invokes the external receiveApproval reentrancy sink.
The receiveApproval external call hands control to an untrusted callee that can re-enter token functions.
During the untrusted callback the allowance state may be re-read or re-written by re-entrant calls.
The owner address is the fixed recipient of the swept external token transfer.
Arbitrary tokenAddress supplied by the owner controls which contract is called.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
The external transfer call returns control to an untrusted token implementation that may re-enter.
The fallback is reachable by any caller sending ether and immediately reverts.
